scope: Proposition A.1 (The local analytic input with changed coefficients) of the manuscript “Pointwise convergence of fourfold ergodic averages for mixing transformations” (preprints/Pointwise-convergence-of-fourfold-ergodic-averages-for-mixing-transformations-October-4-2026/fourfold-ergodic-averages.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 154 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbb86e1a3da44a8b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 25-26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let S = {0} ∪ J, where J is a three-element subset of {1, 2, 3, 4}. Let T be a finite rooted dyadic tree with root K∗ and largest depth d, and let K ⊂ T have kernels satisfying (A.2). For each j ∈ S, let (zj,s)0≤s≤d be measurable scalar functions on K∗. Extend these functions by zero outside K∗. Suppose that {0, . . . , d} has a deterministic partition into Wj ≥ 1 nonempty consecutive blocks, on each of which VB(zj)(y) ≤ W −1/2 j for almost every y ∈ K∗. The partitions may differ between the four roles. Then X K∈K |K| HK,S((zj,s(K))j∈S) ≤ C(c0, C0)|K∗|. (A.4) 25 The constant is independent of the tree, kernels, depth range, and block partitions. It can be chosen uniformly over the four sets S.
